display.name: Per
display.description: The width of each bar over time.

display.name: Tasks finished
display.description: Tasks that reached finished in the selected range.

display.name: Success rate
display.description: Finished tasks as a share of every task that ended (finished, cancelled or failed).

display.name: Median lead time
display.description: Half of the finished tasks took less than this, from creation to finish.

spec.query: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (increase(ariadne_task_lead_time_seconds_bucket{status="finished", repo=~"${repo:regexliteral}"}[$__range] @ end()))) and sum(increase(ariadne_task_lead_time_seconds_bucket{status="finished", repo=~"${repo:regexliteral}", le="+Inf"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0

display.name: Needs you now
display.description: Sessions waiting on you right now: a permission, a question or an error.

display.name: Tokens
display.description: Input and output tokens across every agent run in the range.

display.name: Cached input
display.description: Share of input tokens served from the provider's prompt cache.

spec.query: sum(increase(ariadne_tokens_total{kind="cached_input", repo=~"${repo:regexliteral}", model=~"${model:regexliteral}"}[$__range] @ end())) / (sum(increase(ariadne_tokens_total{kind="input", repo=~"${repo:regexliteral}", model=~"${model:regexliteral}"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

display.name: Goals completed
display.description: Goals completed in the selected range.

display.name: Active tasks
display.description: Unfinished tasks right now, with their trend over the range.

display.name: Tasks ended per $bucket
display.description: Every task that ended, stacked by how it ended.

display.name: How tasks ended
display.description: Finished, cancelled and failed tasks in the range.

display.name: Lead time per $bucket
display.description: How long finished tasks took, creation to finish: the median and the slowest tenth.

spec.query: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (increase(ariadne_task_lead_time_seconds_bucket{status="finished", repo=~"${repo:regexliteral}"}[$bucket]))) and sum(increase(ariadne_task_lead_time_seconds_bucket{status="finished", repo=~"${repo:regexliteral}", le="+Inf"}[$bucket])) > 0

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le) (increase(ariadne_task_lead_time_seconds_bucket{status="finished", repo=~"${repo:regexliteral}"}[$bucket]))) and sum(increase(ariadne_task_lead_time_seconds_bucket{status="finished", repo=~"${repo:regexliteral}", le="+Inf"}[$bucket])) > 0

display.name: Average time in each status
display.description: Where tasks wait: the mean time a task spent in a status before leaving it.

display.name: Finished by workflow
display.description: Finished tasks per workflow.

display.name: Finished by model
display.description: Finished tasks per model, the model on the task's last step.

display.name: How goals ended
display.description: Completed and cancelled goals in the range.

display.name: Tokens per $bucket
display.description: Input and output tokens, stacked by model.

display.name: Token share by model
display.description: Each model's part of the tokens in the range.

display.name: Tokens by seat
display.description: Who spends: the orchestrator, authors, reviewers and keepers.

display.name: Tokens by repository
display.description: Tokens per repository the work ran in.

display.name: Prompt cache hit ratio
display.description: Share of input tokens served from cache. Higher is cheaper.

spec.query: sum(increase(ariadne_tokens_total{kind="cached_input", repo=~"${repo:regexliteral}", model=~"${model:regexliteral}"}[$__range] @ end())) / (sum(increase(ariadne_tokens_total{kind="input", repo=~"${repo:regexliteral}", model=~"${model:regexliteral}"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

display.name: Output tokens per turn
display.description: How much each model writes per turn.

spec.query: (sum by (model) (increase(ariadne_tokens_total{kind="output", repo=~"${repo:regexliteral}", model=~"${model:regexliteral}"}[$__range] @ end())) / sum by (model) (increase(ariadne_turns_total{model=~"${model:regexliteral}"}[$__range] @ end()))) > 0

display.name: Turns per $bucket
display.description: Agent turns, stacked by model.

display.name: Runs by seat
display.description: Agent runs that ended, by the seat they held.

display.name: Average run length by model
display.description: Mean time from a run's launch to its end.

display.name: Runs that ended needing you
display.description: Runs that ended with an attention flag up, by its reason.

display.name: Model switches
display.description: Every switch of model in the range: from, to and why.

display.name: Most used tools
display.description: The ten tools agents called most.

display.name: Attention raised per $bucket
display.description: Every time a session stopped to need you, stacked by why.

display.name: Waiting on you now
display.description: Flags up right now, by reason.

display.name: Median time to answer
display.description: How long a flag stayed up before it was cleared, by reason.

display.name: Permission answers by tool
display.description: The ten tools asking for permission most.

display.name: Who answered permissions
display.description: Answered automatically, by a learned rule, by the AI model or by you.

display.name: Permission answers
display.description: Allowed and rejected requests.

display.name: API latency
display.description: Daemon API request time: the median and the slowest 5%.

display.name: API requests by status
display.description: Requests per second, by response status code.

display.name: Scheduler pass
display.description: Time of one full scheduler pass: the median and the slowest 5%.

display.name: Agent launches
display.description: Agent launches per $bucket, by outcome.

display.name: Database size
display.description: The size of ariadne.db and telemetry.db.

display.name: Daemon memory
display.description: Resident memory of the daemon.

display.name: Daemon CPU
display.description: CPU the daemon uses, in cores.

display.name: Event stream clients
display.description: Clients following the daemon's event stream: the desktop app, consoles and the CLI.

display.name: Warnings and errors
display.description: Recent daemon warnings and errors.
